In 1997 Interplay Entertainment released Fallout: A Post Nuclear Roleplaying Game.
Even though this is the first official Fallout game, it was originally developed as a sequel to 1988’s Wasteland.
After Interplay lost the rights to Wasteland, Fallout took on its own identity with a unique backstory and a grim sense of humour.

This was the first game to be produced by Interplay using the G.U.R.P.S role-playing system (originally developed in 1986) which heavily featured turn-based battle system aiming to unify the “rules” of RPGs.
